title: Collection
description: A released collection (drop) of one brand. Membership is per colour and by id: the variants (and the assets of their colour) whose effective `collection_id` is this `id`. Only released collections are visible; a held collection does not exist for retailers (proposal 0006).

name.description: Display name. Unique per brand and season among records; membership never goes by name.

season.description: Informative; the same name may be reused in another season.

released_at.description: When the collection became visible: the scheduled `release_at`, or the time of the write that released it.
